scope: Frozen171/CANN9.2.0/910C/TP8/DP2/EP16; K03 target M3/CombineV2, K01-K02 long prefill; no new device run

definitions.h: net extra critical overhead EXCLUDING Up throughput loss already in rho
definitions.tau: usable interval after all required routed Cube writes retire, before Vector critical tail finishes
definitions.eligibility: scenario uses first N layer positions, not measured tail availability; cap uses best N as optimistic screen

full_hiding_caps.selection: optimistic largest Up durations; tau unlimited
optimistic largest Up durations; tau unlimited
optimistic largest Up durations; tau unlimited

K03.ordinary_limit: Assumes the point6ms saving transfers to every counted target graph and is fully critical. No prefill credit or DP summation. This transfer is not observed; graph counts/response endpoints are older cohorts.

K01.interpretation: Owner placement saves duplicate projections and wide AG. Fusion-only increment over an equivalent multi-kernel owner implementation is unmeasured and must not receive this same budget twice.
K01.extra_cost_definition: c is unpriced net critical packing/deadline/tiling/contending overhead above modelled local GEMM and narrow-AG replacement; do not subtract those replacement costs twice.

K02.formula: S_joint = S_direct_reference - delta_OA_net_critical; delta includes avoided old transport/layout, new work and interference exactly once

retained_OA_gate.mechanism: A different kernel may fuse OA/send layout or share a larger SMLA/inverse-RoPE/OA producer. The current API cannot emit that packet directly.
retained_OA_gate.formula: Per-window old pack+AllToAll minus1%period minus paired native OA increment. This mixes cohorts only as a conditional screening model;it is not a measured service saving or hard runtime bound.
retained_OA_gate.gate: A new implementation or source-supported schedule must provide a material net case;do not repeat stock permutations or benchmark hot single weights.

K02.interpretation: No aligned joint direct/OA implementation timing exists. This is an incremental penalty budget, not a claimed direct+OA point forecast. The OA gate from a separate cohort is not added to the direct reference.

limits: Input timings are historical serial/profile observations, not new implementation trials.
112 rank windows are correlated and are not112 independent service experiments.
K01 four-carrier envelope is not a clock-aligned request/P90 recomputation.
K02 direct reference and OA gate are different cohorts and cannot be added.
Scenario grids are not device parameter searches or performance trials.
Percentages are elapsed-time reduction ratios, not reciprocal throughput speedups.
No new end-to-end P90 was recomputed; no independent gains are added.
